briefdescription.para: Back-EMF observer of one fast loop period (fast loop, current drive).

detaileddescription.para:
Uses the voltage computed two periods ago (applied during the period that just ended), the measured currents and the commanded angle, then stores v_applied.
m
Driver state; i_meas holds the currents of this period.
sc
Sine and cosine of the commanded angle of this period.
v_applied
Phase voltages computed in this period [pu V].
